text:
Ravi Nair: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: GTM + partnerships. Capturing clarifications so ops/sales/partners can act.
Hannah G.: TL;DR: 1) Renewal triage window = next 90 days w/ ARR >= $20k and any "usage_drop" flag. 2) Partner-led vs self-serve: prioritize partner-led for named ISVs and strategic referral partners; keep bottoms-up funnel as-is. 3) Co-sell crediting: we'll track both influenced pipeline and attributed wins.
Leo Park: For ops: which CRM view to pull and what fields are required for the renewal slide?
ops-bot: Use saved view `renewals_q3_triage`. Required fields: account_name, ARR, renewal_date, product_health_tag, exec_touch. Nightly export to /ops/renewals. Reminder scheduled.
Hannah G.: Routing: pilot approach for Q3 is to keep partner-managed opps until pilot review in Oct. If an opp hits >$150k ARR and needs field coverage, set a joint AE + partner owner and flag in CRM with `joint_gtm=true`.
Ravi Nair: Measurement: Marketing wants partner-influenced pipeline (#), Revenue Ops wants attributed closed-won for comp. Quarterly stretch: +25% influenced pipeline, 6 attributed partner-sourced closes.
Leo Park: PS/SE ask: will partner PoCs get priority? last quarter timelines slipped.
Hannah G.: PS will reserve 15% of capacity for partner-coordinated PoCs for strategic partners. We'll publish a short SLA doc in #partners by Fri.
Ravi Nair: Action items: ops -> share nightly export + renewal slide template by Mon 09:00 PT; Partnerships -> post PoC SLA + partner enablement checklist by Fri; Sales -> tag #partners early and set `joint_gtm=true` for joint deals. I'll send a one-page summary to execs after noon. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Reminder: upload renewal template and nightly export link by Mon 09:00 PT.
Leo Park: Will prep at-risk list and ping ops.
Hannah G.: Thanks all 12
